notes: Answered only from documented biography (Wikipedia article sections pulled via the MediaWiki parse API, Britannica summary, RNZ/1News/NZ Herald/Washington Post/CNN/ABC reporting, Harvard Kennedy School and Earthshot Prize releases, and reporting on her 2025 memoir 'A Different Kind of Power'). Part D omitted - this exercise forbade opening any reading, and no astrological source of any kind was consulted, so A1-A3 are honestly 'unknown': the only public sources for a birth TIME for a public figure are astrology databases, which were deliberately not searched. Documented spine: b. 26 July 1980 Hamilton NZ; raised Murupara (family there ~3 years, mid-1980s) then Morrinsville from about age 8; father Ross Ardern career police officer (joined 1974, ~20 yrs CIB, Matamata-Piako sub-commander), later Niue police commissioner 2005, NZ High Commissioner to Niue 2014, Administrator of Tokelau 2018; mother Laurell (nee Bottomley) school catering assistant; one older sister Louise (Ardern is the younger of two, hence B4 'youngest'); LDS upbringing, uncle Ian S. Ardern an LDS general authority; joined Labour at 17; Morrinsville College from 1994; BCommStudies (politics and PR), University of Waikato 2001, one semester at Arizona State 2001 - no postgraduate degree (Oxford DCL 25 June 2025 and Harvard LLD 2022 are honorary, and the Harvard 2023 appointments were fellowships, not a degree, so A14='graduate'); researcher for Phil Goff and Helen Clark from 2001; New York (soup kitchen, workers'-rights work); London 2006 as senior policy adviser in Tony Blair's Cabinet Office, seconded to the Home Office policing review; IUSY president 30 Jan 2008; list MP Nov 2008; lost Auckland Central 2011 and 2014; won Mount Albert by-election 25 Feb 2017; deputy leader 7 Mar 2017; leader 1 Aug 2017; PM 26 Oct 2017; Neve Te Aroha born 21 June 2018 (Auckland City Hospital); Christchurch mosque attacks 15 Mar 2019; Whakaari eruption Dec 2019; COVID; landslide re-election 17 Oct 2020; announced resignation 19 Jan 2023, out 25 Jan 2023; Earthshot Prize trustee and Christchurch Call special envoy 4 Apr 2023; Harvard fellowships from autumn 2023; married Clarke Gayford 13 Jan 2024 at Craggy Range, Hawke's Bay (engaged May 2019, wedding postponed from Jan 2022 by Omicron); damehood conferred in the 2023 King's Birthday Honours, invested by the Prince of Wales 16 Oct 2024; memoir 3 June 2025 (Ockham general non-fiction prize 2026); documentary 'Prime Minister' Sundance 2025; relocated to Sydney's northern beaches late Feb 2026. Judgement calls and genuinely thin items: A4/A5 - the only clearly documented hospital admission is the June 2018 birth; the late-2022 breast lump was investigated and proved benign, apparently without surgery, so A5='none' and A4='one' may undercount routine care. A6 - 'nerves' is well documented (lifelong anxiety and imposter syndrome, described in the memoir and in her ABC/1News interviews) and 'stomach' rests on her account of childhood anxiety-driven stomach trouble that took her to a doctor; nothing else recurring is on record. A7/A8 - no serious childhood illness or near-death incident appears anywhere in her memoir coverage, so 'average'/'no' rather than 'unknown'. A9 - grandparents' lifespans are genuinely undocumented; searched and not found, hence 'unknown'. A19='above' follows the sourced consensus (international acclaim and honours against domestic criticism of underdelivery on housing and child poverty, approval down to 29% by early 2023), not a personal judgement. A20='some': NZ parliamentary salary 2008-2023 dominates the lifetime total, but London 2006-08 and US/UK/Australian earnings from 2023 are substantial. A23='manageable' is an inference from documented home ownership (Pt Chevalier sold for $1.32m in 2018, then a Sandringham bungalow, sold after she left office); no debt is actually disclosed, and 'none' would be an equally unsourced claim. A29='yes' - she and Gayford were 'told we would need help', were in fertility treatment in 2017, then conceived naturally. A31='extended' records self-described lifelong anxiety, not a diagnosis of depression or documented psychiatric treatment. A35#3 (left the LDS Church in 2005 over LGBT rights) is coded 'spiritual' although the option reads 'turn toward religion' - it was a turn away; A35#9 is the Christchurch attacks and A35#11 the resignation, both coded 'other' because no option fits a national atrocity or a voluntary exit from office. B5='hospital' is inference: born in Hamilton while the family lived in Murupara, and NZ births in 1980 were near-universally hospital births; the specific hospital is not published. B2='medium' - reported heights conflict (1.65-1.75 m) across low-quality sources. B6 omits father_death/mother_death (both parents appear to be living) and own_surgery (none documented). C2='difficulty' rests on the documented harassment, the Richard Sivell conviction for threatening to kill her, the 2022 Parliament occupation and her own account of a hostility 'shift'. C3 low confidence: she has never run a business; the code is scored on her post-office self-employment (bestselling memoir, speaking, trusteeships) going well. C5 low confidence: no institutional confinement at all, only hospital stays, COVID isolation and the constraints of office/security. C10 - no ear or throat pathology is on record and her voice/communication is her documented professional strength, so 'clearly one way'.
